sources.author: NotebookLM (Google), used as a drafting aid
sources.notes: Research/drafting aid only. Per the Product Owner's explicit decision (2026-07-23), this source's type is deliberately distinct from classic-text/academic and must never be a record's sole evidentiary backing - draftOrigin: ai-assisted describes how a draft's text originated, it is not itself an authoritative citation. Every record citing this source (for lineage/transparency) still requires an individually verified sourceVerifications entry by a named human before it can reach red-teamed status.

sources.title: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot
sources.author: Arthur Edward Waite
sources.notes: Public-domain primary/historical source for traditional Major Arcana card meanings (London: William Rider & Son, 1910). Cited here for individual card meanings only (e.g. the Hermit's traditional association with prudence/solitary wisdom-seeking, the Chariot's traditional association with willful triumph over opposing forces) - the specific *pair-relation* connecting two cards is this project's own synthesis and is co-cited with tarot-ai-original-synthesis-v1, not attributed to Waite.

sources.title: Seventy-Eight Degrees of Wisdom: A Book of Tarot
sources.author: Rachel Pollack
sources.notes: Widely cited symbolic/psychological analysis of the Tarot, first published 1980. Cited here specifically for its well-established discussion of Strength as gentle, compassionate inner mastery rather than forceful domination - the individual-card meaning this project's Chariot-to-Strength pair relation draws on. As with Waite above, the pair-relation itself is original synthesis, co-cited accordingly.
